title: What's New: Sales Analytics (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Sales by project report and open source

features.name: Updated PowerBI app for sales
features.description: Enhanced PowerBI application for sales with improved data model and reports including new forecasting capabilities and support for non-item sales types.

features.name: Sales forecasting in PowerBI
features.description: Statistical machine learning model in PowerBI that forecasts future sales based on historical transactions with customizable parameters for seasonality, look-back period, and confidence bounds.
caveats: Requires manual configuration of forecasting parameters in report visuals

features.name: Support for non-item sales types
features.description: Sales analytics now includes support for selling resources and GL account lines in addition to items, particularly relevant for project-based sales.

features.name: Open source PowerBI sales app
features.description: PowerBI app for sales is now open source, allowing users to download the source code (PBIX file) with report visuals and semantic models for customization.
caveats: Only works in version 27 released in October
Does not work for previous versions of the PowerBI app for sales

features.name: Sales by project report
features.description: New report showcasing sales from projects, including resources and GL account lines sold within project scope.

features.name: Excel layouts for analytical reports
features.description: Analytical reports now include Excel layouts enabling interactive analysis with multiple worksheets and pivot capabilities, alongside traditional PDF and Word layouts.

features.name: Word layouts for analytical reports
features.description: Analytical reports now support Word layouts for printable outputs, providing a visual experience similar to the previous PDF rendering while enabling new layout technologies.

features.name: In-client teaching tips for reports
features.description: Teaching tips and help descriptions added to analytical reports, providing inline documentation accessible through captions and the help pane.

features.name: Tell me and Copilot integration for reports
features.description: Report descriptions are reused in the Tell me search and Copilot chat for better discoverability of analytical reports and their capabilities.

features.name: Modernized analytical reports
features.description: All analytical reports in Business Central modernized with new layouts and improved help. Seven reports updated with new layouts and four legacy reports deprecated.
caveats: Four legacy reports no longer needed and deprecated

features.name: Customer item sales report
features.description: Example of a modernized sales analytical report now available with Word and Excel layouts for interactive and printable analysis.
